
{{alias}}( mu, sigma )
    Returns the differential entropy of an Anglit distribution (in nats).

    If provided `NaN` as any argument, the function returns `NaN`.

    If provided `sigma <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    mu: number
        Location parameter.

    sigma: number
        Scale parameter. Must be greater than `0`.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Entropy.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 0.0, 1.0 )
    ~0.307
    > v = {{alias}}( 0.0, 2.0 )
    ~1.000
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 0.5 )
    ~-0.386

    See Also
    --------
